scope: Invalidate an open crop edit on observed source, scene or output context changes. The qualified runtime remains unchanged.

tests.scope: Whole actual CropBoxControl transpiled with an in-memory React hook harness and actual crop math. Unchanged-context Fit/Fill, invalidation before effects, latched invalidation, source/time/dimensions/aspect/current/item/scene/output changes, close/reopen and late Apply guard. Not browser interaction or render/export qualification.

limits: Native UI, pause/time-update behavior, output/scene changes, reopen shape and ordinary Apply/Save remain unqualified. Not a backend concurrency protocol.
releaseGate: No publish until approval and slice verification.
